item.title: Fast-moving star orbits the black hole at our galaxy's center
item.description: Researchers spot a high-speed star near the Milky Way's core, offering clues about its central black hole.

item.title: Kennedy Center delays adding Trump's name to facade until Sept. 8
item.description: New filings show the center won't place Trump's name on the building before September, amid legal requests for a speedy ruling.

item.title: Aitana's 'Superestrella' becomes the surprise Latin hit of the summer
item.description: The escapist track by Aitana has dominated Spanish-speaking charts, and here's why.

item.title: Why does the U.S. military appear challenged in the conflict with Iran?
item.description: Defense analyst Stacie Pettyjohn notes the U.S. military faces shortages of long-range missiles, extended deployments, and vacated regional bases.
